CRITICAL.name: data_freshness_breach
CRITICAL.message: The data pipeline has not run in over 24 hours. Immediate action required to restore data freshness.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and resolve the pipeline failure causing stale data.

CRITICAL.name: data_quality_breach
CRITICAL.message: Data quality has fallen below the 99.9% threshold. This may lead to incorrect financial insights.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Investigate and correct the data quality issues immediately.

CRITICAL.name: row_count_out_of_bounds
CRITICAL.condition: Row count is outside the 17 to 25 range
CRITICAL.message: The row count is outside the expected range of 17 to 25. This may indicate a data processing issue.
CRITICAL.recommended_action: Verify the data processing steps and correct any discrepancies.

WARNING.name: runtime_approaching_limit
WARNING.condition: Pipeline runtime is approaching the 120-minute limit
WARNING.message: The pipeline runtime is approaching the 120-minute limit. Action may be needed to prevent exceeding the limit.
WARNING.recommended_action: Monitor the pipeline runtime and optimize if necessary to stay within the limit.

WARNING.name: data_quality_slightly_below_threshold
WARNING.condition: Data quality percentage is slightly below 99.9%
WARNING.message: Data quality is slightly below the 99.9% threshold. Investigate to prevent further decline.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate the slight drop in data quality and take corrective actions.

WARNING.name: merchant_failure_rate_spike
WARNING.condition: One merchant's failure rate spikes above 30%
WARNING.message: A merchant's failure rate has spiked above 30%. Investigate and address the issue promptly.
WARNING.recommended_action: Investigate the cause of the failure rate spike for the affected merchant.

INFO.name: new_payment_method_detected
INFO.condition: A new payment method is detected in the data
INFO.message: A new payment method has been detected in the data. No immediate action required.
INFO.recommended_action: Log the detection for future reference.

INFO.name: row_count_near_bounds
INFO.condition: Daily row count is near the lower or upper bounds
INFO.message: The daily row count is near the lower or upper bounds but within the acceptable range.
INFO.recommended_action: Monitor the row count to ensure it remains within the acceptable range.
